title: MD-Summoning Registry Entry
description: One JSON-Line per .md file summoned into ~/Meta/Documents

path.description: Absolute path of the original file

hash.description: Full SHA256 hex digest of file content

hash_prefix.description: First N characters of SHA256 for flat/ naming

mtime.description: Last modification time as Unix timestamp (float)

repo.description: Repo-relative path if git-tracked. Empty string for orphans.

repo_root.description: Absolute path to repo root, if git-tracked

depth.description: Depth from home root (orphans) or repo root (tracked)

central_path.description: Path relative to ~/Meta/Documents/ where the file lives

is_symlink.description: Whether the central_path entry is a symlink (true) or actual file (false)

summoned_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the file was summoned

note.description: Optional human-readable note (e.g., warning, error message)
